metadata.methodology: Split-adjusted close and dividend-adjusted close rebased within the selected tenure. One observation per calendar month. Month/year-only appointments start after the uncertain appointment period.
metadata.scaleTreatment: Provider split adjustments retained. No UK currency-scale correction applied to USD series.
metadata.limitations: Public-data research series. Adjusted close is a dividend-adjusted return proxy, not a licensed TSR index. No causal attribution to leadership. Listings may start after appointment. Current-month observation is provisional.
